goal: 7 Clear Steps for Readers to Start Practicing Safely at Home, Reminder to Act within Their Capabilities.

canvas.background: warm cream #FAF6EE, subtle paper grain 5% opacity

header.main_title: Beginner home fitness 7-step guide (no equipment needed).
header.subtitle: Each session lasts 20-30 minutes · First learn the quality of actions, then talk about intensity
header.optional_finished_image: Top right corner rounded square: silhouette of a plank position + green check mark

palette.rule: 3 main colors, each step's illustration in the same flat hand-drawn style

options_explained.use: Odd steps lean left, even steps lean right, connected by curved arrows.

steps.count: Fluorescent blue-purple gradient background steals the spotlight.
structure_per_step: Simplified character or equipment icons (yoga mat/chair)
1–2 lines of description (no more than this number of lines)
items: 01 Clear the Area: Half Square Meter Non-slip Mat, Remove Clutter, Change to Sports Shoes
02 Joint Warm-up: Shoulder Circles, Cat-Cow Pose, Half Squat Circles, Each for 1 Minute
03 Breathing: Nose Inhale 4 Counts, Mouth Slow Exhale 6 Counts, Remember Breathing Throughout Without Screen Division
04 Squat basics: Chair sit-stand 12 times × 2 sets, knees not caving inward
05 Upper body push: Wall push-ups or kneeling position, 8–10 times × 2 sets
06 Core: Dead bug style or side plank, each for 20 seconds × 2, don’t hold your breath
07 Cool down: Forward bend stretch for the back of thighs and chest expansion, each for 20 seconds, drink warm water

connectors.style: hand-drawn curved arrows with 2pt stroke in neutral brown
connectors.rule: Small footprints can be added between steps.

footer.tip: If experiencing chest pain, dizziness, or sharp joint pain, stop training immediately and seek medical attention. Pregnant women and postoperative individuals should follow medical advice.
footer.credit: Family fitness cheat sheet · Can be sent to WeChat family group and friends

must_keep: Each step illustration has the same style
avoid: Write the steps in a 12-line long text
